videos.title: Pick Your Alien, Change Your Play Style
videos.description: A cyclone opens the overview, followed by transformations into a rolling ball and a ground-pound specialist. Natural-pace narration follows the demonstrated powers.
videos.credit: New local Kokoro narration. Original gameplay sources, word timing and caption corrections are preserved in the edit records.

videos.title: The golem has plot armor
videos.description: Four attacks build toward the actual Totem revival. The main phonk drop lands on that reversal, followed by a brief face-aligned freeze.
videos.credit: Music: Phonk Execution by Alex-Productions. Full music credits and meme sound sources are in the audio library below.

videos.title: A Year Before One Full Spin
videos.description: A 37.8-second Venus explainer over a fresh parkour montage. Clean movement from distinct recorded attempts, with natural-pace narration and short phrase captions.
videos.credit: Information from NASA. The gameplay is a montage across attempts, with source cuts documented in the render records.
